baseline_locked.note: Official main-table baseline; all Round7 comparisons must use AdaIN=2.0 protocol

diagnosis_locked.stem_head_capacity: not_bottleneck (LH/HL 31.5/31.1% energy vs LL 25.0%; heads near-orthogonal)
diagnosis_locked.real_bottleneck: conditional pathway (style gate 0.056-0.061; no target-instance condition, only class style_memory)
diagnosis_locked.hf_phase_cancellation: unregistered HF translation RMS 9.4e-9 but Fourier magnitude change 2.0e-8 — pointwise HF regression cancels in phase

round7_plan.step_a: Re-eval target_hf_subband_ft6 with AdaIN=2.0 for fair comparison
round7_plan.step_b: Design phase-anchored HF transport: h_tilde = iFFT(|FFT(h_s)| * exp(j*angle(FFT(h_c))))
round7_plan.step_c: Probe: translation-invariance, LL isolation, HH gradient, conditional-pathway causal
round7_plan.step_d: Main-table 4-metric eval; targets CLIP-S>=0.7075, DINO-C>=0.82, LPIPS<=0.27, DINO-S>0.4859

round7_step_a_result.vs_baseline: CLIP-S +0.012, DINO-S +0.001, LPIPS +0.039 worse, DINO-C -0.035 worse
round7_step_a_result.conclusion: Style slightly stronger but content degraded. Confirms need for phase-anchored approach.

round7_step_b_result.conclusion: Phase-anchored HF transport FAILED. DINO-S dropped below baseline.

round7_step_c_probe.root_cause: Haar DWT + FFT combination is NOT translation-invariant. DWT 2x2 block grouping changes with shift, FFT has boundary effects. This makes FM targets unstable across batches, negating the phase-cancellation fix.

round7_step_d_eval: Same as step_b_result (eval completed in step_b pipeline)

round9_adain_sweep_result.conclusion: AdaIN=2.0 is Pareto optimal. Inference params cannot break DINO-S=0.4859. Sharp cliff above AdaIN=2.0.

round9_experiment.name: pixel_space_wct
round9_experiment.method: RGB-space WCT (3x3 covariance matching) on generated images
round9_experiment.hypothesis: All 35+ prior directions operated in latent space; DINOv2 evaluates in pixel space. Pixel-space WCT may transfer DINOv2-sensitive channel correlations that latent operations miss.

next_action: Waiting for pixel-space WCT evaluation results. If WCT also fails to break DINO-S>0.4859, structural pivot beyond Haar DWT + SAT + FM framework is required.
